title: Ankhorage Reader
summary: Provides a standalone EPUB 3 and PDF reader engine for web and React Native.
purpose: Offer a reusable reading surface for EPUB 3 and PDF documents across web and React Native consumers.
responsibilities: Render EPUB 3 and PDF documents through the public ReaderView API.
Expose reader appearance, navigation, location, status, and error types.
Provide platform-specific web and React Native package resolution.
boundaries: Does not own application document storage or access authorization.
Does not prescribe a product navigation shell around the reader.
Does not require a particular web server or mobile application host.
audience: Web and React Native applications that need EPUB 3 or PDF reading.
Package consumers integrating a document reading surface.
useCases: Render an EPUB 3 or PDF document in a web application.
Render a document reader in a React Native application.
React to reader locations, commands, status, and error events.

architecture.role: Reusable document-reader engine with package-level web and React Native entrypoint resolution.
invariants: The public reader API is exported from the package root.
Web and React Native consumers resolve their platform-specific build through package exports.

limitations: The package supports EPUB 3 and PDF document formats.
